select d.*
from
(select * from ai_knowledge_document where id = #{id} and del_flag = 0 for update) d
ai_knowledge_document d
join ai_knowledge_base b on b.id = d.knowledge_base_id and b.del_flag = 0 where d.id = #{id} and d.del_flag = 0

select * from ai_knowledge_document where del_flag = 0 and upload_status in ('initializing', 'uploading', 'failed') and upload_expires_at <= current_timestamp order by upload_expires_at, id limit 20 for update skip locked
mapper.update: update ai_knowledge_document set upload_status = 'cancelled', upload_error_message = '上传会话已过期', update_time = current_timestamp, version = version + 1 where id = #{id} and del_flag = 0 and upload_status in ('initializing', 'uploading', 'failed') and upload_expires_at <= current_timestamp

update ai_knowledge_document set vector_status =
'not_required'
case when chunk_status = 'confirmed' or vector_status in ('ready', 'processing', 'stale') then 'stale' else 'pending' end
, version = version + 1, update_time = current_timestamp where knowledge_base_id = #{baseId} and del_flag = 0
